englishFull:
End of अध्याय 4.

Summary of pāda 4.4:
- ठक् अधिकार (@ref[4.4.1]-74): plays, digs, conquers, refines, crosses, lives by, conveys, completes, mixes, gives, dwells, practices, etc.
- यत् अधिकार (@ref[4.4.75]-144): bears, pierces, obtains, excellent in, stays, given, kills, praises, property, mantra, month, made by, collection, etc.
- Vedic-specific affixes: ड्यण्, यन्, धन्, घ, तातिल्, etc.
